zh.d:
3.0.6 的修订版，只做一件事：把「换机器」这条路真正打通。3.0.6 的备份在本机导出、本机导入是好的，换到另一台机器导入才暴露问题——正是这个功能存在的理由。同时给备份加上了密码。

【修复】
· 在另一台机器导入备份报「500」或只进来一部分数据：关闭外键约束的语句写在了事务内部，而 SQLite 对此明确是空操作，子表因此先于父表合并
· 合并时本地记录被同名记录替换，挂在它下面的个人设置随即成了孤儿被清掉：现在先把这些引用改指到合并后存活的那条，只有确实无处可挂的才清理，并在结果里报出数量
· 上一条修复自身引入的恢复中断：本地记录与归档记录落在同一个唯一键上时，整个恢复会失败回滚
· 恢复加密备份时不弹密码框、直接报「密码不对」：预览接口一直没把「这个包加密了」这件事告诉界面，界面因此从没问过密码就直接尝试打开——自加密功能上线以来，任何人都没能通过界面正常恢复一个加密备份

【新增】
· 备份加密：导出时设置密码，导入时输入密码才能打开。密码不可找回，界面在写文件之前就会提醒这一点
· 备份文件格式升级到版本 3。3.0.7 仍可恢复旧版本导出的备份；反过来 **3.0.6 及更早的版本无法读取 3.0.7 导出的备份**，会提示先升级——两台机器请都更新到 3.0.7 再互导

en.d:
A revision of 3.0.6 with one job: make moving to another machine actually work. Backing up and restoring on the same machine was fine in 3.0.6; restoring onto a different machine — the whole reason the feature exists — was not. Backups are now encrypted as well.

[Fixed]
· Restoring a backup on another machine returned a bare "500", or brought only part of the data across: the statement disabling foreign keys sat inside the transaction, where SQLite documents it as a no-op, so child tables merged ahead of the parents they need
· A local record replaced by one of the same name took your settings down with it — they were left pointing at a record that no longer existed and were swept away. Those references are now moved onto the record that survived the merge; only what genuinely has nothing to attach to is removed, and the count is reported
· A restore could abort outright, introduced by the fix above: when a local record and an archived one landed on the same unique key, the whole restore rolled back
· Restoring an encrypted backup never asked for a passphrase and just reported the wrong one: the preview response never told the interface an archive was sealed, so it tried to open it without ever asking — nobody has been able to restore an encrypted backup through the app since encryption shipped

[New]
· Encrypted backups: set a passphrase when exporting, enter it to open the archive. It cannot be recovered, and the dialog says so before the file is written
· The archive format moves to version 3. 3.0.7 still restores archives written by earlier versions; the reverse is not true — **3.0.6 and earlier cannot read an archive written by 3.0.7** and will ask you to update first, so update both machines to 3.0.7 before moving data between them
